I found some time for FLT maintenance over Easter, but one thing I never got working was FLT#778 , which simply adds a file with import Mathlib and import FLT to check that we have no name clashes. The hard part is getting it running in CI. Right now it's leanblueprint (or more precisely checkdecls) which is causing trouble -- the error is

Run ~/.elan/bin/lake exe checkdecls blueprint/lean_decls
✔ [2/4] Built Main (513ms)
✔ [3/4] Built Main:c.o (174ms)
✔ [4/4] Built checkdecls:exe (834ms)
uncaught exception: object file '/home/runner/work/FLT/FLT/.lake/build/lib/lean/FLTTest.olean' of module FLTTest does not exist
Error: Process completed with exit code 1.

Any advice on how to proceed?
